A.story: A is for Alligator! 🐊 The alligator loves to eat fresh apples 🍎 from the orchards of Austria 🇦🇹. One day, he put on a helmet and trained to become an astronaut 👨‍🚀!

B.story: B is for Bear! 🐻 Bruno the bear visited Brazil 🇧🇷 and found the most delicious bananas 🍌. He became a baker 👨‍🍳 and baked banana bread every day!

C.story: C is for Cat! 🐱 Clara the cat traveled to Canada 🇨🇦 where she discovered crunchy carrots 🥕. She trained to become a chef 👨‍🍳!

D.story: D is for Dog! 🐶 Dash moved to Denmark 🇩🇰 and discovered delightful donuts 🍩. He became a doctor 👨‍⚕️!

E.story: E is for Elephant! 🐘 Ella explored Egypt 🇪🇬 and loved scrambled eggs 🥚. She became an engineer 👷!

F.story: F is for Fox! 🦊 Felix flew to France 🇫🇷 where fancy fish 🐟 was served. He became a firefighter 👨‍🚒!

G.story: G is for Giraffe! 🦒 Greta visited Germany 🇩🇪 and grew gorgeous grapes 🍇. She became the greatest gardener 🧑‍🌾!

H.story: H is for Hippo! 🦛 Harry traveled to Hungary 🇭🇺 and tasted heavenly honey 🍯. Everyone called him a hero 🦸!

I.story: I is for Iguana! 🦎 Ivan journeyed to India 🇮🇳 and invented incredible ice cream 🍦. He became a famous inventor 💡!

J.story: J is for Jaguar! 🐆 Jaya journeyed to Japan 🇯🇵 and tried yummy jam 🫙. She became the best juggler 🎪!

K.story: K is for Koala! 🐨 King Koala ruled Kenya 🇰🇪 eating juicy kiwis 🥝. He wore a golden crown 👑!

L.story: L is for Lion! 🦁 Leo loved reading in Latvia 🇱🇻, sipping lemon 🍋 tea. He became the beloved librarian 📚!

M.story: M is for Monkey! 🐒 Maya moved to Mexico 🇲🇽 where mangoes 🥭 were magnificent. She became a marvelous magician 🪄!

N.story: N is for Narwhal! 🐋 Nadia swam to Norway 🇳🇴 and found noodles 🍜 floating in the sea. She became a nurse 👩‍⚕️!

O.story: O is for Owl! 🦉 Oliver flew to Oman 🇴🇲 and discovered sweet oranges 🍊. He became an outstanding officer 👮!

P.story: P is for Penguin! 🐧 Pedro flew to Portugal 🇵🇹 and ate perfect pizza 🍕. His dream was to become a pilot ✈️!

Q.story: Q is for Quail! 🐦 Queen Quail lived in Qatar 🇶🇦 and grew the finest quinoa 🌾. Everyone loved their queen 👸!

R.story: R is for Rabbit! 🐰 Rosa raced through Romania 🇷🇴 picking raspberries 🍓. She became a forest ranger 🌲!

S.story: S is for Snake! 🐍 Sam slithered to Spain 🇪🇸 and tasted sweet strawberries 🍓. He became a super scientist 🔬!

T.story: T is for Tiger! 🐯 Tina traveled to Turkey 🇹🇷 and tasted the tastiest tomatoes 🍅. She became the best teacher 👩‍🏫!

U.story: U is for Unicorn! 🦄 Una galloped to Uganda 🇺🇬 and tried udon 🍜. She became an umpire ⚾ at the unicorn games!

V.story: V is for Vulture! 🦅 Victor visited Vietnam 🇻🇳 and discovered vanilla ice cream 🍦. He became a veterinarian 👩‍⚕️!

W.story: W is for Wolf! 🐺 Willow wandered through Wales 🏴 munching watermelon 🍉. She became a wonderful writer ✍️!

X.story: X is for Xenops! 🐦 Xena the xenops flew all the way to Luxembourg 🇱🇺 and tasted sweet ximenia fruit 🍑. No country starts with X, but Luxembourg has an X hiding inside! Then she played a happy tune on her xylophone 🎵.

Y.story: Y is for Yak! 🐃 Yogi stretched in Yemen 🇾🇪 after a bowl of yummy yogurt 🥛. He became the finest yoga teacher 🧘!

Z.story: Z is for Zebra! 🦓 Zara zoomed across Zambia 🇿🇲 where zucchini 🥒 grew in zigzag rows. She became a zoologist 🔭!

Q.rule: Always with U — as in Quail

X.rule: Says “ks” at the end of a word, as in Fox. At the start it often sounds like Z, as in Xylophone
